title: Marketplace Enterprise Onboarding: SSO & KMS Readiness Checklist (Draft)
content:
Purpose:

This doc is a practical, intake-to-listing checklist and microcopy prototype for enterprise marketplace listings that require SSO (SAML/OIDC) and customer-managed KMS (Key management) integrations. Goal: reduce back-and-forth between GTM, Solutions Eng, Security, and Legal; produce copy variants we can A/B for enterprise conversion flows; surface hard blockers early (legal, networking, billing).

Audience:
- GTM / Marketplace ops
- Solutions Engineering (SE) onboarding teams
- Security & Compliance (KMS/SAML owners)
- Legal / Procurement enablement

High-level acceptance criteria (what "ready to publish" looks like):
- Technical gate: SSO metadata exchange flow validated in staging (SE sign-off)
- Security gate: KMS key policy and envelope encryption pattern approved by Security
- Legal gate: Marketplace contract clause drafted + procurement FAQ for customers
- Copy gate: Market listing microcopy variants finalized for SKU + trial offer + entitlements
- Support gate: Playbook for 1st 3 enterprise onboarding runs (runbook + checklist)

Quick intake checklist (initial discovery, to be completed by SE before GTM kickoff):
1) Customer profile: enterprise size, region, compliance needs (HIPAA, SOC2, FedRAMP?)
2) Desired delivery: Hosted (Redwood-managed), Dedicated, or Private (VPC/on-prem)?
3) SSO type: SAML 2.0 or OIDC? SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated? Will customer provide metadata?
4) KMS preference: Redwood-managed KMS vs Customer-managed (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault / GCP KMS / HSM)?
5) Network constraints: Private connectivity required (VPN, Direct Connect, PrivateLink)?
6) SLA/uptime expectations and burst capacity needs
7) Billing model: Marketplace metered usage vs Invoiced commitment
8) Legal flags: data residency, subprocessing, export controls

Technical readiness checklist (SE + infra):
- [ ] SSO: staging tenant created and validated with test IdP (include screenshots of SAML response and SSO login flow)
- [ ] SSO: attribute mapping defined (email, name, groups, role) + role-to-entitlement mapping documented
- [ ] SSO: automated provisioning (SCIM) needed? If yes - SCIM endpoint contract and rate limits agreed
- [ ] KMS: key rotation policy agreed; key ARN/ID exchange procedure documented
- [ ] KMS: envelope encryption verified in staging, with logs showing encryption/decryption events
- [ ] KMS: HSM or BYOK requirements captured for legal/compliance
- [ ] Network: Private endpoints configured for dedicated/private deployments; smoke tests pass
- [ ] Telemetry: traces and service-level metrics exposed to customer (basic console dashboard preview)

Operational & legal readiness (Ops + Legal):
- [ ] Marketplace agreement addendum drafted (highlighting SSO onboarding windows, KMS responsibilities, liability for key compromise)
- [ ] Procurement FAQ: lead times, support SLAs for SSO onboarding, expected docs from customer
- [ ] Data processing addendum (DPA) and subprocessor list updated with dedicated/private infra details
- [ ] Billing: marketplace SKU mapping + pricing tier (trial allowances versus paid entitlements)

Copy prototypes (microcopy mapping for listing tile, detail page, and onboarding emails). Quick variants for experiments. Note: keep short, enterprise tone, and call out deployment modes.

Listing tile (30–60 chars) - variants:
A) "Redwood Inference — Enterprise LLM inference (SAML, KMS-ready)"
B) "Low-latency LLM inference — Private deployments & BYOK"
C) "Secure LLM inference for regulated apps — SSO + Customer KMS"

Detail page headline + 1-liner (variants):
1) Headline: "Predictable, secure LLM inference at enterprise scale"
   1-liner: "Deploy Redwood on Hosted, Dedicated, or Private topologies — integrate with SAML/OIDC and your KMS for full control of keys and data."
2) Headline: "Bring your identity and keys — keep control, reduce risk"
   1-liner: "Streamline SSO onboarding and BYOK key management for compliance-sensitive deployments."

Onboarding email subject lines (first touch):
- "Next steps: Connect your IdP to Redwood Marketplace listing"
- "Action required: Provide KMS key details to enable BYOK"

Onboarding email body (short):
- Intro: thanks for selecting Redwood on the marketplace. To finish provisioning we need: (1) SSO metadata or IdP contact, (2) KMS key ARN or vault name, (3) network contact for private endpoints.
- CTA button text variants: "Provide SSO & KMS details" / "Schedule SSO handoff" / "Complete enterprise onboarding"

UX & metadata fields required for the marketplace form (internals):
- SKU name, short summary, long description, technical capabilities tags (SSO, BYOK, VPC), deployment types supported, trial SKU id, contact for SE handoff, typical onboarding lead time (days), sample entitlements list

Known edge cases & mitigations (note to SEs):
- Customer requires on-prem only (no cloud): escalate to Private deployments team, estimate 8–12 week lead time
- IdP returns inconsistent group claims: plan manual mapping step and flag for legal/procurement about RBAC differences across orgs
- Customer requires HSM-backed signing keys: request security design review early

Open questions / TODOs (quick list):
- Should marketplace listing state "BYOK supported" by default or gated behind SE verification? (ask product & security)
- Who owns automated billing reconciliation for marketplace metered SKUs when using reserved committed capacity? (finance)
- Template language for contract addendum: can Legal reuse existing dedicated contract wording or do we need marketplace-specific clauses? (legal)

Quick rollout plan (short):
1) Finalize copy variants (this doc) + run 2 quick landing page experiments
2) Build marketplace listing draft with required metadata fields (ops)
3) Prep SE onboarding kit (playbook + smoke test checklist)
4) Pilot with 2 customers (solutions eng + GTM) — capture timings, blockers
5) Iterate copy and checklist from pilot feedback, finalize for wider listing

Notes to self / team:
- Marco: can you drop the SSO test plan in the Confluence page linked above? Need concrete screenshots for the marketplace QA checklist.
- Priya: capture 2 sample procurement questions we can pre-answer on the listing (lead time, data residency).
- Aaron: confirm billing SKU mapping with finance for BYOK tiers (GTM-512).

References and artifacts to attach to the listing:
- SE onboarding runbook (link in linked_artifacts)
- Sample SAML metadata file (redacted)
- KMS policy template (security-owned)
- Contract addendum draft (legal)

Rough timeline estimate: 4–6 weeks to first pilot if SE resources are available immediately.

TL;DR: This doc bundles the minimal technical, legal, and copy artifacts we need to launch marketplace listings that target enterprises expecting SSO and customer-managed keys. The big risk is underestimating SE time for idP/KMS handshakes — call that out in pipeline forecasts.
